owner_goal: No meaningful character conversation should remain silent. Spoken performance is a mandatory life layer, not optional polish.
truth_boundary: All 103 currently registered scripted VO cues now have generated external MP3 sources recorded on warehouse/generated-audio-v1. This does not prove WAV mastering, UE import, playback, lip-sync, PIE/device or mix acceptance, and it does not cover all contextual/ambient/effort speech required by the living-world mandate.

policy.naming: One master WAV per existing VO_* cue ID.
policy.performance_rule: Performance follows character state and relationship; never use generic fantasy presets as the sole identity.
policy.rights_rule: Use original or explicitly authorized voices. Do not clone or imitate a specific real film actor voice without explicit authorization.
policy.spatial_rule: Meaningful in-world speech is 3D-attached to the speaking actor when present; controlled fallback only where authored.
policy.mix_rule: Voice has priority over ambient barks and ducks music according to the existing UShireAudioSubsystem contract.
policy.subtitle_rule: Every meaningful spoken line retains subtitle + speaker label.
policy.lip_sync_rule: Production facial rigs receive mouth/jaw timing after audio exists; voice existence alone is not facial-performance acceptance.
policy.loading_rule: Preserve soft/asynchronous ownership and bounded concurrency; do not add synchronous heavy audio loading.

production_steps: Choose one stable original/authorized voice identity for each P1C01 speaker.
Generate or record every listed line as a clean WAV master using the exact cue ID filename.
Review pronunciation, emotional state, pacing, clipping, breaths, room noise and tail silence.
Import under the existing /Game/Audio/Voice/{Speaker}/{CueId} path contract.
Confirm speaker attachment, subtitle timing, cue duration, music ducking and bark suppression.
Add lip-sync/facial timing when production facial rigs exist.
Run real playback without -NoSound and record exact evidence.
Run human PIE listening review and target-laptop concurrency/memory profiling separately.

next_action: Do not regenerate the 103 scripted cues. Prepare durable WAV masters/provenance when storage permits; in parallel produce contextual/ambient/effort speech and the remaining P1C01 complete-audio families. UE import/playback waits for the runner and W00 gate.
